root_runner_pressure.command:
ruby -I scripts -r ./scripts/check_object_typed_dynamic_compact_w189.rb -e '
p = CheckObjectTypedDynamicCompactW189::Probe.allocate
tags = [255,1,0,1]
basic = [0].pack("Q<") + tags.pack("C*")
compact = [1].pack("Q<") + [1,1,255,3,0,1,0,1].pack("C*")
b = p.send(:parse_w189_basic_groups!, basic, "w189", tags, [0,1,3,0])
c = p.send(:parse_w189_compact_groups!, compact, "w189", tags)
raise "positive extents" unless b.map{|x|x[:body_bytes]} == [0,1,3,0] && c.map{|x|x[:body_bytes]} == [0,3,5,0]
header = [0x82,9,8].pack("CVV")
frames = ("\0" * 16 + header) * 2
walk = p.send(:compressed_frame_spans!, frames, "w189")
inventory = {mark_triples: {"w189" => [[0,8,2],[25,0,2],[25,3,2],[50,0,2],[50,0,0]]}}
alignment = p.send(:bind_compact_mark_groups!, inventory, "w189", c, walk.fetch(:spans), 50, 16)
raise "positive coordinates" unless alignment[:normalized_decoded_offsets] == [8,8,11,16,16]
rejections = 0
[
  -> { bad=compact.dup; bad.setbyte(8,2); p.send(:parse_w189_compact_groups!,bad,"w189",tags) },
  -> { bad=compact.dup; bad.setbyte(10,0); p.send(:parse_w189_compact_groups!,bad,"w189",tags) },
  -> { bad=compact.dup; bad.setbyte(13,0); p.send(:parse_w189_compact_groups!,bad,"w189",tags) },
  -> { p.send(:parse_w189_compact_groups!,compact+"\0","w189",tags) },
  -> { bad=basic.dup; bad.setbyte(9,0); p.send(:parse_w189_basic_groups!,bad,"w189",tags,[0,1,3,0]) },
  -> { p.send(:bind_compact_mark_groups!,{mark_triples: {"w189" => [[1,8,2],[25,0,2],[25,3,2],[50,0,2],[50,0,0]]}},"w189",c,walk.fetch(:spans),50,16) },
  -> { p.send(:compressed_frame_spans!,"\0"*16+[0x82,9,1048577].pack("CVV"),"w189") }
].each do |candidate|
  begin
    candidate.call
  rescue RuntimeError => error
    raise unless error.message.start_with?("W189 declared typed-Dynamic probe:", "W187 recursive Array/Tuple JSON probe:")
    rejections += 1
  end
end
raise "adversarial case accepted" unless rejections == 7
puts "BASIC/COMPACT literals and two-frame coordinates: PASS; seven adversarial rejections"
' > /private/tmp/crystal-click-w189-typed-compact.pWG5jt/root-runner-pressure-final.log 2>&1
